summary_claims.claim: Bans social scoring by public authorities, real-time remote biometric ID for mass surveillance without judicial authorisation, subliminal manipulation, sensitive biometric inference and autonomous attack systems
High-impact systems need impact assessment and serious-incident reporting; deepfakes labelled; sandboxes and fines

note: The House's first-debate report supports number, title, filing on 21 Jul 2026, Gaceta 878/2026, rapporteurs, roundtable and the proposed text summarised. The summary describes the text proposed for first debate, not the filed text, and says so. Search found no first-debate vote yet (Comisión VI report of 18 Sep 2026 does not list it as approved). The 'veinticuatro (18) meses' wording in Art. 34 is the source's own.
